//: The shared tasks' TypeScript (tasks/**/*.ts): Node runs each file as it is (no build), and tsc checks them all here. project:typecheck-tasks runs it from the app that includes the tasks. In a consumer this folder is mise's include cache with no node_modules above it, so that task links the app's node_modules next to the tasks folder (beside it, never inside: mise reads every TOML under tasks/ as a task file), and the packages the tasks import (wrangler, node's types) resolve as they do in the app.
